# Notes (Mutable)

You can insert more sub-headings/categories (likely with bullet-points underneath) in this space. 

Some can be placed before the Issue is published. They could cover: 

* useful/relevant resource links known to the Issue creator
* tips/ideas offered by the Issue creator
* something else

Some can also be placed while the Issue is being tackled. They could cover: 

* useful/relevant resource links
* questions/clarifications to coordinate between team-mates assigned to the Issue
* something else

Some can even be placed right before the Issue is closed. These could cover: 

* compromises that had to be made on-the-fly (and may impact future Issues)
* relevant decisions that had to be made (IDs and possibly links to what file/G-Doc they are listed in)
* small tricks/discoveries that do not necessarily have to be recorded in official docs but are useful for understanding the approach to this specific Issue's solution
* something else
